heading: INT. DERELICT MARS SURFACE HABITAT - COMMON ROOM - SOL 412

units.text: INT. DERELICT MARS SURFACE HABITAT - COMMON ROOM - SOL 412
Red dust coats every surface.
A cracked dome overhead lets in amber light.
Cots, a folding table, shelves of dehydrated meals, a dead plant in a coffee tin.
A generator whirs weakly in the next compartment.
MISSION SPECIALIST HARRIET "HATTIE" OKONJO-BELL, 40s, in a faded jumpsuit, sits at the table cleaning a helmet visor with a rag.
Her hair is chopped short.
Her eyes are tired but sharp.
DR. LEOPOLD ASHWORTH, 60s, leans against a shelf, wrapped in a thermal blanket, coughing into a fist.
A gray beard has grown unevenly on his cheeks.
COMMS OFFICER RENATA KWIATKOWSKI, 30s, kneels beside a dead radio set with a screwdriver, muttering in Polish.
Any luck?
units.name: HATTIE

units.text: It's the transmitter. The coil's burned through.
units.name: RENATA

units.text: Can you fix it?
units.name: HATTIE

units.text: With what? A paper clip and a prayer?
units.name: RENATA

units.text: I have a prayer.
units.name: LEOPOLD

units.text: Save it for the oxygen.
units.name: RENATA

units.text: Hattie sets the visor down.
A faint rumble builds in the walls.
The three of them look up.
Dust trickles from the dome.
Another quake?
units.name: HATTIE

units.text: No. That's an engine.
units.name: LEOPOLD

units.text: Renata drops the screwdriver.
They all stare at the ceiling.
The rumble grows, a roar, then a shriek of thrusters.
A shadow slides across the dome, long and dark.
A final shudder.
Silence.
Then a hatch clanks at the far end of the room.
It swings open.
A figure in a white suit steps through, visor up, face lit by the amber glow: CAPTAIN WILHELMINA "BILLIE" TSANG, 50s, with a rescue beacon in one gloved hand.
Hello, Hattie.
units.name: BILLIE

units.text: Hattie rises very slowly.
Her rag slides from the table.
You came back.
units.name: HATTIE

units.text: I said I would.
units.name: BILLIE

units.text: You said it forty times.
units.name: LEOPOLD

units.text: And I meant it forty times.
units.name: BILLIE

units.text: Renata crosses the room in three strides and throws her arms around Billie's suit.
The visor clacks against her forehead.
She laughs and sobs and swears in Polish.
Hattie stays where she is, one hand on the back of a chair.
How long do we have?
units.name: HATTIE

units.text: Eleven minutes before the dust storm.
units.name: BILLIE

units.text: Then we go.
units.name: HATTIE

units.text: We go.
units.name: BILLIE

units.text: She hands the beacon to Leopold, helps him up, drapes the blanket across his shoulders.
He leans on her.
The generator sputters and stops.
In the sudden quiet the dead plant in its coffee tin catches the light from the open hatch, and for one moment, it looks green.
